description: tools/generate_nz_target_references.py generates NZ v0 held-out references. H1 counts national positive-payment recipients and H2 compares annual model dollars with historical Accommodation Assistance expenditure. Neither enters calibration. Treasury and WFF remain exempt until their named prerequisites close; historical observations retain their source periods.

target_references.name: msd_accommodation_supplement_recipients_national

metadata.measurement_basis: National positive-payment recipient count; June 2026 snapshot stock, not annual recipients or dollars.

target_references.notes: H1 compares the June 2026 national recipient stock with family units whose accommodation_supplement_rounded_weekly_payment exceeds zero. The declared positive-payment indicator counts each unit once, with factor 1; it never sums dollars. The national fact avoids a Work and Income region to Stats NZ region bridge. MC5 holds this comparison outside calibration.

target_references.name: msd_annual_report_accommodation_assistance_expenditure

metadata.measurement_basis: Historical fiscal-year 2024/25 Accommodation Assistance expenditure versus annualised model dollars; no period alignment or AS-only scope claim.

target_references.notes: H2 annualises accommodation_supplement_rounded_weekly_payment by 52 and compares model dollars with the historical fiscal-year 2024/25 Accommodation Assistance line in MSD Annual Report 2025. The published appropriation may cover more than Accommodation Supplement; this comparator makes no AS-only scope claim and never uprates the historical observation. The selector pins msd.benefit_expenses.fy2024 because the feed repeats this amount in another record set.

target_references.name: treasury_an24_01_accommodation_supplement_fiscal_total
target_references.notes: Treasury Analytical Note AN 24/01 fiscal_totals.csv, Accommodation Supplement row, tax year 2018/19 (targets doc T4, CC0). A secondary historical comparator only; it is never scaled or uprated to the model year.

target_references.name: ird_wff_recipient_families
target_references.notes: Held out as the Working for Families tripwire (IRD WFF statistics, targets doc I3). Cell-pinned IRD administrative count of families with a claim and non-zero final entitlement, not every eligible family and not cash paid. Chronicle owns the September 2025 workbook facts. Activation requires a separate family receipt/claim state and an explicit bridge from tax year ending 2024 to the 2026-27 build basis. Total and average entitlement NZD remain held-out validation, never calibration values. No v0 graph node computes WFF, so the comparison is parked until the WFF modules are bound.

target_references.name: ird_wff_recipient_families_by_family_income_band
target_references.notes: IRD WFF recipient-family income distribution (targets doc I3, 2020 onward): the one published conditional slice of the joint-income distribution, reported as the joint-income tripwire. Held out; never calibration.
